name: 13-get-first-round-match
description: GET /api/fixture/RMA/BAR returns the match. RMA:BAR is a first-round match in Mule's HashMap order; its date is relative to 'now' and its score is random, so only those fields are ignored.

source.reference: rest-api-with-apikit/src/main/java/org/mule/examples/leagues/model/League.java (buildFixture: HashMap<String,Team> iteration; first round dates now-7/-6 days at 18:00 with random scores); response/Match.java
